claim: Agentgateway's standalone EPP inference routing (PR #1658) is deliberately fail-closed: if the EPP is unavailable or omits the x-gateway-destination-endpoint header, the gateway errors instead of routing to service endpoints.
stance_target: fail-open vs fail-closed behavior when trusting an EPP-returned destination
scope_conditions: agentgateway standalone EPP passthrough routing as of PR #1658
quoted_support: That PR intentionally keeps standalone inference routing fail-closed. If EPP fails or does not return x-gateway-destination-endpoint, agentgateway returns an error instead of routing directly to service endpoints.

claim: As of the issue's last update (Jun 22 2026), agentgateway has no merged design for fail-open fallback in standalone EPP mode; maintainers are undecided between configured fallback endpoints, a non-passthrough discovery mode, or separate virtual-model failover.
stance_target: maturity/completeness of agentgateway's fail-open design for non-k8s backends
scope_conditions: agentgateway issue #1661, open as of fetch date
quoted_support: A real FailOpen design would need one of these: Fallback service endpoints configured and tracked. A non-passthrough mode that includes service endpoint discovery. Separate backend failover, like virtual model failover (not the same as EPP fail-open).

claim: A maintainer-proposed fail-open design ties fallback behavior to an explicitly configured fallback pool: EPP down with no fallback pool still errors (same as fail-closed), while EPP down with a fallback pool routes through normal service load-balancing.
stance_target: possible fail-open design for non-k8s backend routing
quoted_support: EPP down + no fallback pool → error (same as failClosed) EPP down + fallback pool → route through fallback pool
